bullets: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: add WARN for interactive controls (Button/toggle/etc.) that have neither x:Name nor AutomationProperties.AutomationId — they are unaddressable by UI Automation and their Content text collides with same-named NavigationView items, making live controls read as dead in parity capture.
MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: add prominent 'Interactive controls need a stable AutomationId' section (rationale + before/after) generalizing the previously camera-only AutomationProperties mention.
SKILL.md: add a Fidelity Critical Rule to give every interactive control lacking a name a stable AutomationProperties.AutomationId derived from its Click handler/purpose.
